title: Maximum residue levels for maleic hydrazide
summary: EU increases MRLs for maleic hydrazide on animal products from 5 November 2026
update: The European Union (EU) has increased the maximum residue levels (MRLs) for maleic hydrazide on a wide range of animal products.
impacted_products: Products of animal origin (swine, cattle, sheep, goat, horse, and poultry), milk, birds’ eggs
what_changing: The EU has increased the MRLs for maleic hydrazide on most animal products (see Table 1).
why: Following an application for a change of MRLs by the producer of maleic hydrazide, the European Food Safety Authority concluded that increasing the MRL would not pose a risk for consumers ( EFSA 2025 ).
timeline: The new MRLs apply from 5 November 2026 .
background: MRLs are set in accordance with the rules set out in Regulation 396/2005 . For information on current MRLs for other substances, please consult the EU Pesticide Residues database . For further information on the setting of import tolerances, see Pesticide residue import tolerance MRLs explained .
resources: EFSA (2025) Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance maleic hydrazide . EFSA Journal, 23(7): e9522.
title_fr: Limites maximales de résidus pour l’hydrazide maléique
summary_fr: L’UE augmente les LMR pour l’hydrazide maléique sur les produits d’origine animale à compter du 5 novembre 2026
impacted_products_fr: Produits d'origine animale (porcins, bovins, ovins, caprins, équidés et volailles), lait, œufs d'oiseaux
